entry.title: I Got Isekai’d Into Miraculous—Now They Want Me to Break the Love-Square?! Tch. I’m a Robin. I’ll Fix It My Way.
entry.summary:
Author: krono2011

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 251,981Chapters: 95/98Kudos: 675

Summary: Five years Damian waited for the last Miraculous Ladybug manga, and the ending sucks. Enraged, he boasted he could write a better story. A mischievous, fifth-dimensional imp quickly appears and gives him a chance to prove his claim. To prevent a disappointing ending, he must change the plot as he sees fit. What would a genius detective, Robin, do in the MLB Universe, to cause Chaos of course! ​He wakes up in a world where he is dead, but Alfred is his living ally. With just seven days until the plot kicks off, Damian dedicates himself to healing the fractured Batfamily, slowly putting the pieces back together. But he can multitask. To prevent the Love Square, he decides to aggressively befriend Marinette Dupain-Cheng the only way a Wayne knows how: by replacing her friends with competent ones and burying her under a mountain of gifts. Who knew purchasing platonic affection required so much cashmere? (I am currently writing the final arc. )

entry.title: Orbiter
entry.summary:
Author: BewitchingHex

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 31,088Chapters: 1/1Kudos: 48

Summary: Damian remembers… someone. A woman, probably, saying, “I love you.” He remembers moments of joy, of tears, of loss and of love. He remembers her teasing him about him being too serious and the shape of her in his bed. He just doesn’t remember who it was he shared those memories with. Her face is blurred in every picture in his mind. He remembers part of his vows, too, but never a name. He remembers how deeply he loved her.He searches for her in every person, in the strangers on the street, in the villains he puts away. He knows her and he won’t stop searching until she is found.Marinette watches from afar as her husband exhausts every avenue to find her. She watches as he tears himself apart, again and again in an attempt to remember. She is careful to stay out of his way, only allowing brief moments of viewing him in his work. She remembers the choice she had to make, only to lose him either way. A thousand lives, or everyone's memories of her. He wouldn't have let it go, but she is starting to realize that he isn't letting her go now either.

Summary: "Don't look at me like that." "Like what?" "Like you care about me"Damian learns that the mantle doesn’t simply belong to him. it isn’t his birthright. It isn’t something *he* owns. It doesn’t belong to anybody; it is simply a mantle that can fly wherever it pleases. Entirely free like a bird, and how stupid would it be to chase after something he can never truly catch? Follow Damian as he learns to change and let go of titles, while striving to be the best version of himself, one that can make his older brother and father proud, but is change possible if his history is carved into his skin?What better way to leave your past behind than to disappear in Gotham? The second Marinette heard her class was going on a field trip, she started planning her escape, Marinette wants to experience one last good summer, like the ones you see in those coming-of-age movies—but can she do that with a ticking clock above her head? During her pursuit of a good summer, Marinette crosses paths with a beautiful tragedy in the form of a fragile girl who has striking similarities to someone she wants to leave in her past. Is the summer she wants only a Reverie?

entry.title: The Soulmate Story
entry.summary:
Author: Legacy_K

Rating: Not RatedLanguage: EnglishWords: 7,237Chapters: 10/10Kudos: 55

Summary: In a world where floating orbs expose the truth of every bond, secrets don't stay buried for long. Years ago, the day the orbs appeared nearly tore society apart-gold marked soulmates, blue marked friendship, black marked enemies. Simple. Brutal. Unforgiving. Marinette Dupain-Cheng learned early that the colors never lied. So when the balance of Paris shattered and the Miraculous fell into the wrong hands, she made a choice no hero was meant to make: she ended Hawkmoth, she ended Adrien Agreste, and she took back the power that was never meant to be theirs. Now the world calls her many things like murderer, traitor, threat and with the Justice League closing in and Paris no longer safe, Marinette lives in the shadows, carrying blood on her hands and silence in her chest. The orbs still hover. Still judge. Still reveal truths she would rather not see. Because fate isn't finished with her yet when Marinette finally meets the quiet, sharp-eyed boy whose orb burns pure gold beside hers, the world might just break all over again.
